messages:
alyssa: Heads up — hit a customer onboarding failure when they rotated API keys mid-stream. sampleapp opened a long-lived streaming connection and then their new key was pushed; our SDK just closed with a 401 and didn't attempt any refresh/reconnect.

mike: Ugh. Which SDK version + sampleapp? Any logs or minimal repro?

alyssa: Repro on local + production. SDK 1.14.0 (rolled earlier today). Minimal log:
```
[stream] got frame error: 401 Unauthorized
http: Authorization Bearer <REDACTED> - token expired
[stream] connection closed by server, no reconnect attempt
```
We expect it to either refresh credentials or keep accepting the old key for a small grace window.

lina: SDK used to try credential refresh for streaming (1.12.x) — we changed precedence for env creds in 1.14.0 (project-level env now overrides user creds) and I think that removed the refresh path for open streams. Also note env var names: `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, `REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY`, `REDWOOD_KEY` — confusing.

sam: Two quick ideas: (1) server-side grace window where old key accepted for N seconds after rotation and server emits `x-rotation-grace: <secs>` header to signal clients; (2) SDK implements streaming auth refresh handshake: when a 401 on stream happens try to fetch updated credential source and resume without dropping data. Pseudo: 
```
onAuthError() {
  if (canRefresh()) { refreshCreds(); reconnectResume(); }
  else { emit('auth_failure') }
}
```

devops-bot: deploybot: rolled out sdk-server 1.14.0 to prod 12 minutes ago (hash: a1b2c3).

mike: If 1.14 changed env precedence, that explains it. Can you confirm which credential sources the sampleapp uses? (env > config file > metadata?)

alyssa: sampleapp uses `REDWOOD_KEY` in CI and falls back to `~/.redwood/credentials` locally. In CI we now set project-level key via env which replaced the user key mid-flight.

lina: OK — short-term: server-side grace seems safest (non-breaking). Medium-term: SDK should try transparent streaming refresh. I can add server header support but need an API decision on grace duration and audit logging.

sam: I'll open a SDK PR to reintroduce streaming refresh fallback gated behind a feature flag `REDWOOD_ROTATE_STREAMING=true` so we can test without turning it on by default. I'll include a small exponential backoff reconnect + resume logic.

mike: Plan sounds good. Alyssa — can you add a quick note to the sampleapp README about rotation gotchas and env precedence? Mention `REDWOOD_KEY_ROTATION_GRACE` env var as a temporary diag knob.

alyssa: Yup — just pushed a README snippet and a minimal repro script to the sampleapp repo. Link: https://git.redwood/sampleapp/rotate-repro (private).

lina: I'll draft a server proposal with a default 120s grace window and audit events for rotations. Ping me on the doc when you're ready.

sam: PR will target 1.14.x patch (1.14.1) with the flag and tests. cc @mike for review.

mike: Tasks: sam -> PR for SDK streaming refresh; alyssa -> sampleapp doc + repro; lina -> server header + proposal. We'll treat this as a P0 DX bug for onboarding customers. :thumbsup:
